dmn_experiences.title: The Tennent's Brewery Tour
dmn_experiences.summary: A guided tour of Wellpark Brewery covering the full brewing and packaging process, finishing with a fresh pint of Tennent's Tank Beer.
highlights: See how ingredients are selected and beer is brewed
Behind-the-scenes look at the tanks, bottling and canning lines
Complimentary pint of brewery-fresh Tennent's Tank Beer
Explore the brewery's heritage centre
Several start times through the afternoon

dmn_experiences.title: Scottish Gin Tasting - Highlands
dmn_experiences.summary: A two-hour tasting at Gin71 on Renfield Street exploring five gins from the Scottish Highlands, with an arrival cocktail.
highlights: Five Highland Scottish gins to sample
Arrival cocktail included
Hosted at Gin71, home to a large artisan gin range
Two-hour guided session
Over-18s only

dmn_experiences.title: Whisky Blending Experience
dmn_experiences.summary: A whisky blending evening at Arisaig in Merchant City with a two-course Scottish dinner, where you create and take home your own blend.
highlights: Brief history of whisky from the Whisky Ambassadors
Two-course dinner cooked with seasonal Scottish ingredients
Blend four malt whiskies using pipettes and tasting notes
Take home a personalised 100ml bottle
Set in Glasgow's Merchant City

dmn_experiences.title: Cocktail Masterclass
dmn_experiences.summary: A cocktail masterclass at Saints of Ingram, set in a historic Glasgow dining hall, covering cocktail history, classic recipes and the venue's signatures.
highlights: Welcome glass of prosecco and canapes
Set in a 200-year-old Grand Dining Hall
Learn classic cocktails and venue signatures
Open to groups, pairs or individuals
Over-18s only
